notes: Original full primary paper unavailable: DOI landing returned 403 challenge; Unpaywall and OpenAlex reported no OA fulltext; Project MUSE alternative returned verification HTML. No original statistics extracted from the replication report. Replication OSF URL 7qjzp is a file, not a project node; resolved via the en9md project named in the supplied reference and verified its title and final-report file. No specific test locator or neutral description was supplied, so target_match remains null. Replication report uniquely identifies its focal Analysis One retained coefficient. The report narrative says 11,110 person-year observations, whereas the fitted regression table prints 1,980 observations; n uses the latter for the same test as es and p. The report describes primary-grade retention but methods restrict retained cases to grades 5–7 and define hschool from transcript course-grade codes; retain these documented operationalisations without adjudicating validity. The narrative percentage/exp expression is internally inconsistent with its printed coefficient; no conversion or correction was performed. Success is the authors explicit verdict. Printed p = 0.000 retained without reinterpretation.
